caption: The drawing features a single ornate sofa with an elaborately carved wooden frame. The wood is a deep brown color, richly detailed with floral and scroll motifs along the top rail, armrests, and lower front edge. The sofa has three legs visible in the drawing, each ending with a small brass wheel. The upholstery is a patterned fabric with shades of pink and red, adorned with subtle floral and damask designs that cover the seat, backrest, and interior arms. The backdrop is plain, with a beige-toned background surrounded by a simple double-lined rectangular border, accentuating the central focus on the sofa.
title: Sofa
